## About Me

I'm a **Data Science and Machine Learning Engineer** with 8+ years of experience building and deploying AI and machine learning systems. My work focuses on developing practical, scalable AI solutions that turn complex data into actionable insights.

I hold two Master's degrees in **Applied Mathematics** and **Data Science**, and I'm a graduate of **École polytechnique** and **ENSAE ParisTech** in France.

I'm also **AWS certified**, with certifications in **Data Engineering** and **Generative AI Development – Professional**.
